name: party_bigwipe
note: Volvox party piece: the arm idles through a library generated for this stage and, on a trigger (TouchDesigner, OSC), plays a sequence or sweeps an LED strip across UV paper. Edited by hand or by the Houdini show scene. The canvas and the scan are PLACEHOLDERS until the paper and strip are decided (the canvas is the plane of the user's cat curve).

rest.note: the stage home; dance phrases (anticipation, overshoot, follow-through, breathing)

greet.note: the tool looks at the audience; gestures and spatial paths

canvas._note: The fab team's canvas, standing on the floor: kept deliberately LARGE (2.4 x 1.8 m, floor to 1.8 m) -- the real one, smaller, sits inside it, and only collisions matter (the user, 2026-09-29). No frame. Its face on the old scan's plane (1.097 m out from J1's axis), centred on the arm: the plane's foot of J1's axis. The plane runs 1.76 m left and 1.85 m right of that between the TV wall and the back wall. Measured on the arm 2026-10-01: the bar laid flat on the wall by hand (joints -110.935 -72.548 50.41 -155.95 -80.795 89.134) -- its facing the wall's normal (0.6 deg off the earlier plane: 10 mm over the bar's 1 m), its front (the CAD's, the shade's rim) on the face, 2.5 mm nearer than before at 1.57 m high. Kept upright: the 37 mm face pressed by hand gives no trustworthy lean (it said 1.9 deg, which the 8 mm scan would have hit at the bottom). Then a tape at the scan's start put the 6.3 mm scan 8 mm from the paper: the bar pressed flat had sat a little in it -- the face 1.7 mm further, as the tape says (the user: the tape is the reference).

scan._note: One pass down, the 1 m strip laid level (scan_roll 90), over a 1.0 x 1.0 m area: the strip's length wide, 0.5-1.5 m high, centred on J1's axis. The top is what the controller's work zone allows: its Z 1600 mm cap (a WebUI safety setting, not ours to change) less the ramp and lead above the area; the arm reaches from 0.2 m. Its middle 1.0 m high, 0.6 m under a standing guest's eyes. Speeds as the old scan's (write slower with show_stream --scan-speed). The LEDs' face 2 mm from the paper, the nearest the user asked for (2026-10-01: 3.5 cm too faint, 8 mm good, nearer better): the scan and its moves keep 0.8 mm from it (margins.scan_canvas_m), the bar's collision model 0.93 mm past its rim. At 0.15 m/s: on the arm 0.15 painted best of 0.15-0.4 (the user, 2026-10-01).

audience.note: where people stand: outside the left partition, out of reach (placeholder)

greet.note: where the TCP performs for them

range._note: the show's operating range: the directions the arm may face (J1), the TCP's height band, the fraction of the measured limits clips are made at

showpieces._note: the strip upright, three strokes left-right along the front wall (partition_left); from low: greet's upright strip sits at the ceiling margin
the strip level, four strokes up and down; 0.8-1.4 m is the height the level tool reaches across the wall
